items: 【NOTE】Due to the inherent properties of diatomite and its long-term sealed state during transportation, there may be a slight smell of diatomite,In a dry environment, the color may also become lighter. This is a normal phenomenon, the smell can be removed by washing it with clean water and drying it,the color will also return to a darker shade during use.Please don't spill dark drinks such as coffee, red wine on the dish drainer mats. It may leave marks on it.

【Elegant and Practical】The water absorbent drying mat features an elegant design inspired by stone, with a gray base highlighted by refined dark gray marbling. This color combination adds a touch of luxury and style to your kitchen, enhancing its overall aesthetic.The large-sized mat can be rolled up for storage, it's an ideal solution for kitchen saving space.Whether it's a new home/apartment/studio apartment/dorm room/first apartment, it's always an essential part of your aesthetic kitchen.

【Suitable for most dish drying racks】The large-sized drying mat is 24" long and 16" wide. It is larger than most dish drying racks and can be fully compatible with various dish drying racks and used together. If you don't want to use it in combination with the rack, you can simply place the dishes that need to be dried directly on it for drying.

【Food-Grade Material & 30s Fast Dry】Made from premium diatomaceous earth and PVC, this stone drying mat for kitchen counters is carefully tested for security, even when in contact with food, and is completely safe. Its highly absorbent material quickly soaks up water, keeping your countertops dry and devoid o dampness.

【Large & Small Set】You’ll get 1 large & 1 small drying mats , 1 sanding tool and 1 non-slip pad. The large stone drying mat is ideal for drying dishes and utensils, cups, bottle and other tableware. The small drying mat can be used as a soap holder or a coaster or a sponge holder for kitchen sink.

【Wide Application】The large stone drying mat acts also as a heat-resistant mat, protecting countertops from hot pots and pans. kitchen drying mat also doubles as a bath mat, plant saucer, or pet feeding mat, offering flexibility for various home uses.

【A Wonderful Gift】Collapsible stone dish drying mat helps maintain a clean kitchen, ensuring your surfaces stay neat and fresh,it is a fashionable essential item for the kitchen.This stone drying pad is an ideal gift for your loved one!
